audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer gave Galio all seven stages while Hwei wins 56.63% of 2331 games — packet.defects flags this outright: "level chart contradicts data". The full layer separately read "Skill" on all seven rows, so the two layers also disagreed with each other on every row.
audit.why: The kit does not support a lane Galio owns from level 1. His poke is Winds of War at 825 units; his engage is Justice Punch at 650 and Shield of Durand at 275. Hwei paints from outside all three. Hero's Entrance is a 180-second ultimate at rank 1 that lands on an ALLY's position — it decides fights elsewhere on the map, not the 1v1. Where Galio genuinely takes over is two items in, when tank stats plus a 5500-unit engage make him the fight-starter.
audit.corrected: Full and content both set to Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Galio, proposed as paired rows. phases[4].side was already "Skill" so only its win[4] twin needed changing; every other row is a matched pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claimed tank items make Galio "nearly unkillable to your poke" — a magnitude with no source — and spikes[1] said Hero's Entrance lets him "flash-taunt onto you or a teammate from across the map", which is not what the ability does.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Galio designates an ALLY's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies." He cannot target you with it; he lands on his own teammates. Range is 4000/4750/5500 and the cooldown 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Spikes now state that it is his jungler and bot lane that make the ult dangerous, with the real range and cooldown attached, and the tank-item spike is framed as blunting chip without granting reach.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer had Galio's kit substantially wrong: it credited him a "passive shield (Runic Skin)", called Winds of War his W, and attributed the knock-up to his Q. Hwei's own tools were called "EE fear", "EQ root" and "WW speed paths".
audit.why: Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-attack reset that deals bonus magic damage in an area — there is no shield on it, and "Runic Skin" is not a name in this kit. Winds of War is the Q (825 units); Shield of Durand is the W (275 units, taunt plus shield); the knock-up is Justice Punch, the E, a 650-unit dash that knocks up the first enemy CHAMPION it meets. Hwei's E sub-abilities are Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE) and his W paints are Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights — the speed paint is Fleeting Current on WQ, not WW.
audit.corrected: All four slots restated correctly; the counterplay is now bait Shield of Durand, stay outside 650 units, and hold Grim Visage (EQ) for the dash landing.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E text, ranges and cooldowns

Hold Flash for the dash cutting your retreat — you have no dash of your own.

edits.before: Galio's Hero's Entrance at level 6 is one of the most oppressive ultimates against squishy mages — a global flash-taunt engage means there's no safe positioning against him once he's grouped for a fight, and his tank stats let him shrug off your burst combo entirely. edits.after: Hero's Entrance at 6 is a map tool more than a lane tool — it lands on an ally's position from 4000 units, shields them and knocks up whoever is nearby, so it is his jungler and his bot lane that make it dangerous. edits.before: Nothing improves for you late — Galio's tank itemization makes your poke largely irrelevant while his ultimate continues to force unfavorable engages onto your backline. notes: This was the worst matchup in my slice. packet.defects already flagged the chart as contradicting the data — content gave Galio 7/7 stages against a 56.63% Hwei win rate over 2331 games — and the full layer separately said "Skill" on all seven, so no two of the three sources agreed. I moved both layers to Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Galio as matched pairs (phases[4] was already "Skill", so only its win[4] twin needed the edit, and win[6] was already "Galio" so only its phases[6].side twin did). I rated my own confidence Medium on the exact shape of that chart, not on the fact that the old one was wrong. QUESTION FOR THE USER, recorded rather than acted on: diff is "TRICKY" with diffRating 7/10 and carryRating 7.5/10, which now sits oddly against a Hwei-favoured chart and a 56.63% win rate. I did not touch those, or breakdown.difficulty and report[14] which quote them, because changing the rating means changing four coupled strings and I would rather he decide the number. Beyond the chart, the content layer had Galio's kit substantially wrong: it invented a passive shield called "Runic Skin" (Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset with no shield), labelled Winds of War as his W (it is the Q), and attributed the knock-up to his Q (it is Justice Punch, the E). It also said Hero's Entrance can "flash-taunt onto you" — Riot's text is explicit that he designates an ALLY's position, so the ult is a threat through his teammates, not a point-and-click on Hwei. Did NOT assert whether minions block Justice Punch: Riot's text says it knocks up the first enemy CHAMPION, which the old wants.you[1] line contradicted, so I removed the claim rather than reverse it.
